title: Reverse Survivors: director powers (ambush, frenzy, rift)
objective: Give the director three powers beyond spawn/wave/boss, buying back some control over where enemies appear. Ambush places a unit next to the survivor at a premium, Frenzy drives the horde harder for six seconds, and Rift pins spawns to one edge for ten. Placement becomes purchasable rather than free.
acceptance_criteria: `npm run check` passes standalone: tsc --noEmit clean, eslint --max-warnings 0 clean, vitest at 100% on all four metrics.
Existing seeded replays are unaffected: the unpinned edgeSpawnPos path draws the same RNG values in the same order as before.
Ambush placement is deterministic and draws no RNG.
Ambush lanes never repeat, including past a full turn.
Frenzy scales every damage channel - contact, projectile and blast - not just melee.
Each power is independently gated by cooldown and affordability, and rejects cleanly when either fails.
out_of_scope: Difficulty tiers, which ship as a separate commit.
Letting the player choose the ambush unit: the bar binds it to a fixed cheap unit so SpawnBar stays a pure snapshot-to-buttons function with no local state.
verifier: npm run check (typecheck + eslint --max-warnings 0 + vitest --coverage at 100%), plus director.test.ts assertions on cooldown gating, lane rotation across 24 summons, and rift edge pinning
